item.title: Texas State partnership to build rocket motor testing facility raises aquifer concerns
item.description: Texas State University’s Freeman Center Ranch is set to become home to a new solid rocket motor testing facility, raising concerns for some resident's due to its location.

item.title: Early Travis County election results may be delayed in the March primaries. Here's why
item.description: When polls close on Election Day and Austinites start eagerly refreshing their phones for election results (which we're sure you get on KXAN.com), it may take longer this primary election because of a shift in early voting tabulations.

item.title: DA announces retrial for APD officer accused of deadly conduct in 2022 fatal shooting
item.description: On Wednesday, the Travis County District Attorney’s Office announced it would move forward with a retrial for Daniel Sanchez, an Austin Police officer accused of deadly conduct.

item.title: All clear at Georgetown High School after reported bomb threat
item.description: Georgetown High School was placed on lockdown Wednesday “due to a reported threat,” according to police.

item.title: Warmth through Thursday, but changes start Friday
item.description: Sunshine increases during the late morning through the afternoon on Thursday bringing our warmest temperatures of the week ahead. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Austin Police officer 'indefinitely suspended' after 6th Street punching incident
item.description: An Austin Police officer who allegedly punched a man during an incident on East Sixth Street has been fired from the department after an internal investigation.

item.title: Residents on Riverside Drive share impact of construction
item.description: People who live and work along East Riverside Drive said they’re used to heavy traffic — but many said the latest detours tied to the I‑35 Capital Express Central project are the worst.

item.title: Hutto police gives all-clear after family violence suspect arrested
item.description: The Hutto Police Department (HPD) said Wednesday afternoon that residents near the 100 block of Holland Street should stay inside while it deals with a "critical incident."

item.title: 'Horrible injustices': Four men previously accused of Austin yogurt shop murders expected to be formally cleared
item.description: After spending decades of their lives wrongly accused of one of Austin's most infamous crimes, four men previously believed to have killed four teenage girls at the I Can’t Believe It’s Yogurt! shop on Anderson Lane in 1991 will finally see their names cleared.

item.title: Trial against alleged 'Antifa cell' tied to shooting at Texas ICE detention facility set to begin
item.description: The trial against nine people arrested in connection to a shooting at an Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention facility south of Fort Worth in July 2025 is expected to start next week. The trial had been scheduled to start this week, but on Tuesday, the judge in the case declared a mistrial.
